C. I. C.
F. C. Rsd
L 190
2/5/22

Memorandum on letter from F. Parlani to
S.A. Serebriannikoff.

Mr. S.A. Serebriannikoff, a Russian merchant,
recently died, followed a few days later by his
wife. As Russians are subject to the Mixed Court
jurisdiction his estate was put into the hands of
the official Court Accountants, Messrs. Seth, Man-
cell and McClure, for administration. On going
through Mr. Serebriannikoff's papers Mr. McClure
found two photographic copies of a letter address-
ed by F. Parlani, an Italian subject, to Mr. Sere-
briannikoff. Considering that the contents of
this letter were such that they should be brought
to the notice of the proper authorities, he handed
me one copy, which I attach. It will be seen that
in this letter Parlani makes the statement that a
certain receipt which Serebriannikoff has given
him is of no value and only given to him to enable
Serebriannikoff to "benefit through the influence
of the Italian Assessor" in his case against the
Lung Hwa Tannery. I have examined the file of the
case in question, S.A. Serebriannikoff and F. Par-
lani vs. Vong San Tsien (M.C.C. No. 2756) and it
is clear that the receipt referred to in Parlani's
letter was used to make it appear that there was
an Italian interest in the case and so obtain the
presence on the bench of the Italian Assessor.
The history of this case is interesting. If Sere-
briannikoff had sued by himself, the action would
have been tried by the Russian Assessor and Chinese
Magistrate /

F. C. Rsd
L 190
2/5/22

关于 F. Parlani 致 S.A. Serebriannikoff 信函的备忘录。

俄国商人 S.A. Serebriannikoff 先生最近去世，数日后其妻子亦随之去世。由于俄国人受会审公廨管辖，其遗产已交由官方法院会计师 Seth、Mancell 和 McClure 先生们进行管理。在清理 Serebriannikoff 先生的文件时，McClure 先生发现了两份由意大利籍人 F. Parlani 致 Serebriannikoff 先生信函的照片副本。鉴于该信函的内容性质应当引起有关当局的注意，他将其中一份副本交给了我，现附后。由此可见，Parlani 在此信中声称，Serebriannikoff 出具给他的某张收据毫无价值，出具该收据仅是为了使 Serebriannikoff 能够在其对龙华制革厂（Lung Hwa Tannery）的案件中“通过意大利陪审推事的影响力获益”。我查阅了相关案件的卷宗，即 S.A. Serebriannikoff 和 F. Parlani 诉 Vong San Tsien 案（会审公廨刑事案件第 2756 号），显然，Parlani 信中提到的收据被用来制造该案有意大利利益关系的假象，从而促使意大利陪审推事出庭审理。此案的历史颇有意思。如果 Serebriannikoff 单独起诉，该诉讼将由俄国陪审推事和中国谳员审理 /

Magistrate. On the strength apparently of the
receipt given to him by Serebriannikoff Pariani
posed as Serebriannikoff's partner and sued
jointly with him, thereby bringing in the Italian
Assessor. The petition was filed on July 10th
1920, and on November 5th 1920 an order was made
by the Court (Magistrate, Russian and Italian
Assessors) that defendant was responsible, as
Manager of the Kwan Chu Tannery, only in the
event of the proprietors not being found, or exe-
cution not being obtained against them. Meantime
defendant was held on security. An application
for a rehearing was immediately filed by plain-
tiffs, but before it came on for hearing Serebri-
annikoff withdrew on February 28th 1921 so that
the case continued as purely Italian case before
the Italian Assessor Mr. Ross. Copy of Serebrian-
nikoff's letter of withdrawal is attached.
On March 4th 1921 the application by plaintiff
for a rehearing was dismissed but defendant was
ordered to remain under security for two weeks
more. On April 9th security was extended for six
weeks to enable plaintiff to collect new evidence.
On May 23rd 1921 the following order was made:
"Plaintiff to keep goods supplied by defendant and
defendant to pay damages which are assessed in the
sum of 59,600 dollars. Defendant to give man and
money security "
Defendant, not being able to satisfy the judg-
ment, was taken into custody on the same day and
remained in custody until January 10th 1922, when
I understand he made some composition with his
creditor and was released.
The /

谳员。显然凭借 Serebriannikoff 出具给他的收据，Pariani 以 Serebriannikoff 合伙人的身份出现，并与他共同起诉，从而引入了意大利陪审推事。诉状于 1920 年 7 月 10 日提交，1920 年 11 月 5 日，法院（谳员、俄国及意大利陪审推事）作出命令，被告作为关珠制革厂（Kwan Chu Tannery）经理，仅在找不到业主或无法对业主执行判决的情况下才承担责任。在此期间，被告需提供担保候审。原告随即申请重审，但在开庭审理前，Serebriannikoff 于 1921 年 2 月 28 日退出，因此该案作为纯粹的意大利人案件继续在意大利陪审推事 Ross 先生面前审理。附 Serebriannikoff 退出函副本。
1921 年 3 月 4 日，原告的重审申请被驳回，但命令被告继续提供担保两周。4 月 9 日，为使原告能够收集新证据，担保期延长六周。1921 年 5 月 23 日，作出如下命令：
“原告保留被告供应的货物，被告支付损害赔偿金，金额核定为 59,600 美元。被告需提供人和金钱担保”
被告因无力履行判决，于同日被拘留，并一直被羁押至 1922 年 1 月 10 日，据我所知，当时他与债权人达成某种和解协议后获释。

The original of this letter is not forthcoming
but the photograph appears to be genuine, though
it is difficult to understand why Serebriannikoff
should have preserved the photograph and not the
original. It is also difficult to understand the
date (January 31st 1920) for no proceedings were
started until nearly six months later.

此信原件未能找到，但照片看似真实，尽管难以理解 Serebriannikoff 为何保存照片而非原件。此外，日期（1920 年 1 月 31 日）也令人费解，因为直到近六个月后才启动任何法律程序。
我已将此信副本出示给代理意大利总领事 □□□□□□ 上尉及 □□□□ □□□□□□。

COPY

February 26th, 1931.

N.A. Ivanoff, Esquire,
Russian Assessor,
International Mixed Court,
Shanghai.

Sir,

Please note that having settled all my out-
standing account with Mr. F. Pariani, I have in
consequence thereof assigned to him all my inter-
ests and rights in my case against Fung Nan Chi,
now pending in the Mixed Court on the question of
rehearing, and request you kindly to inform the
Registrar of the Mixed Court to this effect.

I have also informed the Italian Assessor to
this effect, who, I understand will continue the
case for Mr. F. Pariani as the only plaintiff in
this case.

Thanking you for your kind attention.

I am, etc.,
(Sd.) S.A. Serebriannikoff.
pages.zh:
副本

1931 年 2 月 26 日。

N.A. Ivanoff 先生，
俄国陪审推事，
上海国际混合法院。

先生，

请注意，在与 F. Pariani 先生结清所有未决账目后，我因此将我在针对 Fung Nan Chi 的案件中的所有权益和权利转让给他，该案目前正就在混合法院重审一事待决，恳请您将此情况告知混合法院书记官。

我也已将此情况通知意大利陪审推事，据我了解，他将继续作为本案唯一原告 F. Pariani 先生处理此案。

感谢您的关注。

此致，
(Sd.) S.A. Serebriannikoff。

REPORT ON Chinese Stock Exchanges registered in the
Italian Consulate

Made by D. I. Sullivan Forwarded by Director of Criminal Intelligence.

Sir,

There are three Chinese Stock Exchanges promoted
jointly by Chinese and Italian subjects registered at the
Italian Consulate. The names and other details of the
exchanges are as follows :-

The Foreign Chinese Produce and Stock Exchange Co.
Ltd, 15/16 Canton Road. Promoters : Chev. Emilio Bacci,
Elison Calatroni of the Ausonia Co., 66 Szechuen Road ;
A. Enrico Lauro of the G.D. Russo Law Office ; Frederico
Parlani of T. Funder & Co., 40 Nanking Road. Mr. Lauro
acts as legal adviser for the establishment of the firm.
The Chinese managers are Sung Teh Pei (陳德培), comprador
of Maitland & Co., 11 Peking Road, and Fan Yung Tsang
(范詠蒼), interpreter to Mr. G.D. Russo who is legal
adviser to the exchange. The exchange has not started
to do business.
